text: Coffee with Anil. He starts at the new firm on 3rd of June, finally out of the bank. His wife Deepa is throwing him a leaving do sometime next week. Text him on the day to wish him well. He's also finally booked the honeymoon they never had, Crete in early October, so the new place is letting him take it before his probation ends. Deepa says he's been sleeping badly with the nerves though.
Adaeze rang. Housewarming at the new flat is 14 May, she said bring nothing but I'll take wine anyway. Her brother Tunde is helping her move the sofa this weekend.

Dong got the promotion! Team lead from early March. He's a bit nervous about managing people who used to be his mates. Need to take him for a drink end of the month. His boss Francesca is apparently leaving around the same time, which he thinks is why it happened so fast. His girlfriend Saskia is chuffed, she's planning a little dinner for him on the 9th and asked me to keep it quiet.
Caught up with Sunil and Lola at the school gate. They're doing a joint 40th, 21/06, garden party if it doesn't rain. Lola's mum is flying in for it. I'm doing the playlist.
Ben's retiring after 31 years at the council. Do is the last Friday of the month at the Crown. Card going round, must sign it before Wednesday.
Aneesh mentioned he's been made redundant, very matter of fact about it but I could tell. Interviews lined up over the summer. Check in with him sometime next week, no pressure.
Tiago's first day at the hospital was yesterday. Said the nurses are lovely, the commute is awful. Ask him how week one went on Friday.
Simone invited us to dinner on 2nd of November. Her partner Georgia is cooking, she's vegan so don't bring the cheese board again.

Saskia's leaving drinks got called off, the new job fell through at the last minute. She's gutted. Maybe pop round with cake one evening this week. Her boyfriend Milan reckons the company pulled the offer because of budget cuts, and she'd already handed her notice in at the old place. Luckily her old boss said she can stay until the end of the month while she looks. She's applying everywhere.

Long call with Olga. She's moving to Leeds for the job end of September, starting there 1st of October. Her dad's not thrilled. She wants to do a farewell dinner sometime mid-month, I said I'd host. Her cat Boris is going to her sister's until she's settled.
Bea (Beatriz) is having a birthday thing on 9 December, small, just drinks. She keeps going on about a decent coffee grinder, hint hint.
Uma said Noor got into the graduate scheme at Deloitte! Starts in September. Send Noor a congrats message tonight.
Picked up the dry cleaning, booked the car in for 12/11. Still need to sort the gas bill.
Aaliyah and her husband Michael are having an engagement party for her cousin on 5th of April. They asked if I could do photos. Said yes. Need to charge the camera batteries beforehand.
Tamar starts her new role as head of design after half term. She's been at the agency seven years. Proud of her. Get her flowers for her first day.
Milan was quiet at football. His dad's going in for a hip op early next month and Milan's taking time off work to look after him. Ring him once the op's done.
Emily's back from Lisbon. Loved it, wants to go back over the summer with her sister Lin. She's started at the new school too, teaching Year 6 now.
Ignacio's housewarming - Saturday 18th, 7ish. Address in WhatsApp. I'm bringing the speaker.
Georgia and Nikhil have set a date! Wedding 22nd of August next year. Save the dates coming end of the month apparently. Nikhil's best man is his brother Darius.
Darius had his probation review today and passed. Contract's permanent now. He sounded so relieved. Must send him a congrats text.
Elijah's surprise party for his mum's 70th is 3rd of June. Don't mention it to her if I see her at church. He wants a group photo printed by the 1st.
Anya: interviewing at Spotify next Thursday, final round. Really anxious about the presentation part. Text her good luck the morning of.

Kenji is leaving Tokyo office and coming back to London sometime in early spring. His partner Francesca has already found a flat in Hackney. Plan a welcome back dinner once they're settled. Francesca's veggie. Kenji's starting at the Shoreditch office in mid-April and says the role is basically a promotion in disguise. Their son starts nursery in September too, so it's a busy year. Francesca asked if I knew any good removal firms, send her the one we used.
Call with Mrs Fischer about the leaving collection for Anil. Everyone's putting in a tenner, gift is a watch. I said I'd collect from the second floor by 14/05.
Saw Adaeze at the shops. Her mum's not well again, back in hospital since Sunday. She's exhausted. I should drop off some food sometime this week.
Tunde got the head chef job at the new place on the high street, opening 1 March. He asked if we'll come to the soft launch the week before. Definitely going.

Sunil's struggling at the new job. Manager is micromanaging, long hours, hasn't seen the kids properly in weeks. Meet him for lunch next week, his treat he said but I'll pay. His wife Simone thinks he should go back to the old place, they'd have him tomorrow. He's got his three month review on 19th of November and is dreading it. Might be worth texting him the night before.
Lola told me Ben's daughter had a baby girl on Tuesday, Ivy. Ben is over the moon. Get a card for Ben and his wife.

Noor's dinner party is off, her flatmate tested positive. Rescheduling to sometime in early December instead. She'd already bought all the food, so she's freezing it. Her flatmate Lin is fine apparently, just tired and annoyed she's missing her own work Christmas do on the 28th. Noor said she'll send round a new date once they're sure.
Deepa's 50th! Weekend away in the Cotswolds, 7th-9th of March. Anil's organising it, he wants to keep it a surprise. Deposit is due end of January, need to transfer him my share.
Olga called from Leeds. First week done, team are great, flat is tiny. Her dog Pickle hates the stairs. She said come up sometime over Easter.
Book dentist. Renew passport before the end of the month. Return the parcel.
Milan and Simone are hosting Christmas drinks on the 20th. Simone asked me to bring mince pies. I'm going straight from work so will be late.
Michael (Mikey) from five-a-side starts at Arsenal's analytics team on 2nd of February. Lifelong Gooner so he's buzzing. Ask him about it after his first week.

Talked to Uma for ages. She's thinking of leaving teaching altogether, maybe retraining as a nurse. Her husband is supportive but money's tight. Starts an access course in September if she goes for it. Her son Aneesh just started secondary too so it's a lot. She asked me to send her the link to that bursary page. Do that tonight.
Beatriz's retirement lunch was lovely. Forty years at the library. She cried during the speeches. Follow up with her in a couple of weeks to see how she's finding it.
Housewarming at Tiago and Lin's on 30th of November. They've finally bought the place in Walthamstow. Lin asked for plants rather than booze.
Francesca's sister Lola is getting married in Italy over the summer, she's maid of honour and totally stressed about the speech. Offer to read it through for her.
Kenji's farewell from work is Thursday. He's been there since uni. Going to the drinks after, then I'm driving him home.
Elijah promoted to deputy head from January! Celebratory curry with him and his wife Saskia on the 12th. Saskia mentioned he's been eyeing up a new briefcase, could be a nice gift.
Nikhil passed his driving test this morning, third attempt. He's taking his mum to the seaside on Sunday to celebrate.
Need to call Aaliyah about the 21st, she wasn't sure if it's still on. Her brother Ignacio's leaving party, before he goes to Madrid on 3rd of January.
Dong's wife Lin is due early March. They're doing a small baby shower sometime in February. Dong seems nervous but excited. Don't forget to ask what's on the list.
Anya says her flatmate Georgia got the job at the BBC. Starts in a fortnight. Anya's throwing a little party for her on the 14/10, invited me.
Chat with Tamar's partner Darius at the barbecue. They're moving to Bristol end of the summer for his new job at the uni. Tamar hasn't found anything there yet and is a bit worried about it.
Simone's work anniversary, 10 years at the firm on 1st of July. Her boss is taking the team out. Thinking of sending her something small.
Deepa's back at work after maternity leave from Monday. Nervous about leaving the baby at nursery. Text her Monday evening to see how it went.
Phoned Dr Ahmed's office, results back 15 May. Will ring them that afternoon.
Ben said his son Elijah has been offered a place at Edinburgh, starts in September. Ben and his wife are driving him up in the first week. Ben looked a bit lost about it all honestly.
Aneesh MacDonald, new guy in accounts, invited the whole floor to his housewarming next Saturday. Seems sound. Into climbing and board games.

Tunde and his girlfriend Adaeze are throwing a joint leaving do before they go travelling in early January. Six months in South America. Date TBC but sometime mid December. Tunde said he'd send the details.

Lunch with Noor, Uma and Kenji. Noor's started at the charity, loves it. Kenji's thinking about going part time to look after his dad. Uma just got back from Kerala. Arrange another one for sometime in early spring. Kenji's dad has a scan on the 2nd and Kenji's clearly worried, so I should check in with him after that. Noor's birthday is end of the month too, she mentioned wanting a new yoga mat.
Sorted the venue for my own birthday on 28/03. Booked the back room at the Fox. Still need to send invites.

Ignacio's mum Beatriz is turning 80 on the 4th of August. Big family lunch, I'm invited. He said she'd love anything to do with gardening. His wife Tamar is doing the cake and his brothers are flying in from Valencia the day before. I'm not sure I can get the 3rd off work so might have to drive down early that morning. Look at train times this weekend and order something from the garden centre by end of July.

Darius is so anxious about his first solo presentation to the board, 2nd of December. He's been rehearsing every night. I'll send him a good luck text the night before. His wife Emily says he's barely sleeping.
Francesca's last day at the paper is Friday, then she's freelance. Leaving drinks at 6. I'm going but leaving early for the train.
Olga Kowalski rang to say thanks for the flowers. Her new job is going well, got her own team already. Promised to visit her early next year.
Nikhil's restaurant opening got pushed, the kitchen's not finished. Now looking at early March. He's frustrated but sanguine.
Milan's sister Anya is getting married on 3rd of June. Hen do in Brighton sometime in May. Milan's giving her away since their dad passed. Remind me to ask Milan how the speech is coming along.
Quiet one. Walked the dog, did the shopping, made soup for the week. Nothing to note.
